description: This file defines a controller class 'Filter' within the Opencart admin namespace, responsible for handling post-processing tasks after filtering actions such as editing or deleting filters. It adds tasks to update product information based on filter actions.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class that handles event-driven actions after filter editing or deletion, primarily scheduling tasks to update related product data.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Handles the post-filter edit event by scheduling tasks to update product info for products associated with a specific filter ID.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Handles the post-filter delete event by scheduling tasks to update product info for products associated with a specific filter ID.
